review_kind: manual protected contract port; no automatic approval exception
patch_delta: Protection hunks are unchanged from 0.164.0 apart from release stamps (167 workspace Cargo.lock versions, one more crate than 0.164, and the initialize user-agent) and the hand-merged PreCompact hunk below.

reviewed_contracts.compaction: 0.165 builds PreCompact hooks with environment requirements hooks. Those are discovered as HookSource::System at <environment:ID>/requirements.toml and cannot satisfy the required SessionFlags /<session-flags>/config.toml identity, so they can only stop compaction. Preview and run now share one hook set. Every history-replacement and compaction-inference caller (local, remote V2, token-budget new_context, Op::Compact entry points) is still dominated by run_pre_compact_hooks; there are no new callers. Async scheduler and direct background paths remain refused.
reviewed_contracts.approval_result: Live-auto checks remain on every user, reviewer, PermissionRequest-hook and Guardian path: command, write_stdin, apply_patch, network, MCP tool-call and request_permissions. run_permission_request_hooks gained a target environment and still runs between the pre- and post-review checks. Final grants are still sanitized and recorded under the active_turn lock that publishes the tightening.
reviewed_contracts.execution: Patched live approval-policy reads still sit on the live paths after upstream moved remote proxy launch into remote_network_proxy_launch. The executor-cannot-launch-proxy refusal stays fail-closed. New exec-server review-domain support checks are fail-closed.
reviewed_contracts.turn_settings: turn_processor and v2 turn settings are unchanged upstream. doxaAuto still cannot be combined with other updates, and the ThreadSettingsApplied resume de-duplication affects thread defaults only.
reviewed_contracts.new_entrypoints: Environment hook execution (hook_environment_executor) is unreachable: EnvironmentConfig has no Deserialize, environment_ready has no non-test caller, and every production constructor uses empty environment_hooks. Guardian recorded-item forwarding is off by default, and DOXA drops notifications for foreign thread ids. thread/memory/read, fork attachToSource and the gcp provider do not touch permissions, hooks or sandbox, and DOXA sends none of them. No new model tools. agents.enabled=false and multi_agent_v2=false still resolve to MultiAgentVersion::Disabled.
reviewed_contracts.build_inputs: Unchanged: Rust 1.99.1 (codex-rs/rust-toolchain.toml) and the official V8 152.2.0 archive/binding release manifests, byte-identical to 0.164.0.

noted_not_regressions.execpolicy_amendment_after_switch: Present since 0.164.0: session/handlers.rs exec_approval persists an ApprovedExecpolicyAmendment before the live-auto post-review denial. Unreachable from DOXA, whose host answers only accept/decline and rejects amendment decisions. Candidate hardening for a later port.
noted_not_regressions.context_management_token_budget: Present since 0.164.0: with features.context_management=true, a supporting model and a Plus/Pro plan, session/token_budget.rs can enable TokenBudget at runtime despite the CLI override. Resets remain gated by run_pre_compact_hooks. Candidate hardening: also pin features.context_management=false.

compiled_verification: Separate hash-bound build and compiled guard proof required; this static review record is never an acceptance receipt.
